data.title: Family Affairs Council Launches Campaign to Mark World Children's Day
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Family Affairs Council has launched a campaign to mark World Children's Day. Running from November 20 to 22, the initiative brings together government entities alongside organizations from the private and non-profit sectors.
    Aimed at raising awareness of children's rights and highlighting the family's role in their care and upbringing, the campaign focuses on four key pillars: providing a safe environment, offering psychological support, fostering skill development and talent discovery, and educating the public on children's rights.
    Throughout the campaign, awareness messages are being disseminated across the platforms of the council and its partners to underscore the family's role in fostering an environment conducive to children's growth and capability development.
    -- SPA
